author: vince502
body:
#### PR description

 This PR enables single-leg conversion recovery in Run 3 PbPb events with configurable HF tower sum threshold. It keeps the recovery disabled above the proposed threshold  (5300 GeV) and adjusts the conversion seeding and
 track-building settings for PbPb.

Tested with 10k 2025 data, the impact on timing is around 3% increase w.r.t. baseline, memory increase not seen, and edmEventSize shows the miniAOD increased by 0.44% from the increased number of conversion candidates. Performance
 results are in the slides (https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1fzZ5sLEpsCBc4Lwnf1KxEU9RLMv37LvENaWI4WcZksk/edit?usp=sharing).
 
 The default behavior would not alter the reconstruction settings, as the max hf threshold should be set explicitly.

 #### PR validation

 Tested with MC workflow 160.03 and data workflow 141.301. Both passed. For 141.301, I replaced the input with a 2023 PbPb RAW data file.

 #### Backport

 No backport planned.
title: Adding HF filtered conversion single leg recovery for Run 3 PbPb
